verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides the building blocks for tightly scoped cards, but the evidence shows no turnkey single-use card. Authorization controls can restrict spending to a single merchant. Velocity controls can cap both amount and transaction count over a time span. JIT funding lets your system approve or deny each authorization with your own rules, and card transitions let you change a card's state after use. A developer would have to combine these themselves to get a one-purchase, exact-amount card. Missing for 10: a documented single-use or burner card feature, explicit exact-amount matching, automatic card termination after first use, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the combined controls behave as a single-use card.
